dct_description_sm: Point features displaying the different types of water system valves apart of the City's water system network. Water system valves are classified as butterfly valve, gate valve, hydrant gate valve, zone valve, and fire lane gate valve. These valves block the pipe either partially or completely to change the amount of fluid that passes through it. Updated as an ongoing process.
